page_title: DOR 1-0 WOL | Dortmund v Wolfsburg 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Dortmund take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Dortmund win a corner.
90+3' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
90+2' A player from Wolfsburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Dortmund have a free kick from a promising distance.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
89' The attendance for today's match is 81365.
88' Substitution. Lovro Majer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg).
86' A spell of possession for Wolfsburg in an attempt to control the game.
83' Here is a change. Marco Reus is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Emre Can (Dortmund).
81' A lofted cross from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is replacing Tiago Tomas.
78' A substitution has been made. Niclas Fullkrug goes off and Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) comes on.
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) coming on for Jonas Wind.
78' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Mattias Svanberg will be replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
77' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
75' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
72' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
72' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 7:10.
68' 1 - 0 Goal! Marco Reus (Dortmund) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Julian Brandt. The score is 1:0.
67' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Koen Casteels.

66' What a great effort! Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
65' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) replaces Vaclav Cerny.
63' Here comes a substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens is given a rest as he is replaced by Donyell Malen (Dortmund).
63' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
61' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
60' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
55' This shall not pass! Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
54' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
54' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolfsburg was in an offside position.
52' Total attempts – 6:5.
48' PENALTY APPEAL after Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball after the free kick and takes good first touch to unleash a low shot from close range, but Koen Casteels makes a nice save.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
43' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar.
41' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
41' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 3:2.
38' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Gregor Kobel is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.
36' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
34' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
33' Dortmund players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
29' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
26' An attempted cross from Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
24' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
22' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
20' That's unlucky! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
19' The ball rebounds to Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
18' Sven Jablonski blows the whistle, Marco Reus (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul. Wolfsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
17' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends the corner into the box, but Koen Casteels intercepts it and averts the threat.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 60:40.

14' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Sven Jablonski stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to Dortmund.
12' The resulting corner from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) is cleared.

12' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
10' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) will take a corner kick.
10' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
8' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

5' Marco Reus (Dortmund) was close to scoring from the resulting free kick. He unleashed a decent strike from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper made a great save to keep him out.
4' Poor challenge! Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Dortmund.
4' Some patient build-up play from Dortmund as they look to unlock the defence.
2' One of the players from Dortmund times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski is the one to supervise the game today.
